title: Initial rate schedule · CTR-001
lines: SYNTHETIC DOCUMENT. Not a customer agreement.
Standard RN service rate: USD 60.00 per hour.
Effective service dates: October 1 through October 4, 2026.
All other components require separate approval.

title: Approved rate amendment · CTR-001-A02
lines: SYNTHETIC DOCUMENT. Not a customer agreement.
Effective October 5, 2026, the standard RN service rate is USD 65.00 per hour.
This replaces the prior standard RN rate of USD 60.00 for services on or after that date.
Earlier service dates retain the prior rate, irrespective of the time-entry date.
Approved by DEMO-APPROVER on October 3, 2026. All other components are outside this sample rule.

title: Approved rate schedule · CTR-002
lines: SYNTHETIC DOCUMENT. Not a customer agreement.
Standard RN service rate: USD 65.00 per hour, effective October 1, 2026.
Callback, holiday and overtime terms are not included in this sample rule.
